_schema: Aggregates from harness.db harvest_attempts (frozen copy of 2026-10-06 12:00 CDT, read-only, rows t < 2026-10-06 12:00 CDT). gaps: seconds between consecutive success/fail attempt rows 1-30 s apart (consecutive chops at one stand/tree), split at script pace go-live 2026-10-04 22:34 CDT; hist bins 0.5 s from 1 to 20 s (gaps >20 s omitted from hist, kept in n/median). outcomes: attempt outcome counts per harvest era, split at the first Smart Harvest 'nothing_near' row (2026-10-04 22:07 CDT); Smart Harvest writes one 'nothing_near' row per tree marked, so its nothing_near is counted per answer (1,403 marks grouped <=1 s apart = 1,125 answers; job_events rows mentioning nothing_near: 1,124). capture: target-to-target medians from NOTES.md 'First live room-storage trip' (session 20261004_220218).
